question: Calculate the percentage of players who prefer the left foot at least once across all available season records and were born between 1987 and 1992.
final_sql: WITH per_player AS (SELECT p.player_fifa_api_id, MAX(CASE WHEN pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS left_flag FROM Player AS p JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p.player_fifa_api_id = pa.player_fifa_api_id WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthday) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1987 AND 1992 GROUP BY p.player_fifa_api_id) SELECT 100.0 * SUM(left_flag) / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM per_player;

final_sql: SELECT f."FRPM Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS eligible_free_or_reduced_price_meal_rate FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.SOC = '66' AND f."School Type" = 'K-12 Schools (Public)' AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" IS NOT NULL AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" IS NOT NULL ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC LIMIT 5

final_sql: WITH RECURSIVE tag_split(tag_string, tag) AS (SELECT p.Tags, substr(p.Tags, 2, instr(p.Tags, '>') - 2) FROM posts AS p INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' AND p.CommentCount = 0 AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL AND p.Tags <> '' UNION ALL SELECT substr(tag_string, instr(tag_string, '>') + 1), substr(substr(tag_string, instr(tag_string, '>') + 1), 2, instr(substr(tag_string, instr(tag_string, '>') + 1), '>') - 2) FROM tag_split WHERE instr(tag_string, '>') > 0 AND substr(tag_string, instr(tag_string, '>') + 1) <> '') SELECT DISTINCT tag FROM tag_split WHERE tag IS NOT NULL AND tag <> '' ORDER BY tag
